extracted.intended_audience: grant administrators, researchers, policymakers, and historians tracking funded science education projects
extracted.subtask_description: A tabulated listing of funded science-education projects showing institution, principal investigator, project title, grant/project code, project duration, and awarded amount. The page is a historical/administrative record of awarded grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution
rubrics_metrics.description: The organizational recipient of the award (e.g., 'LEHIGH UNIVERSITY', 'PENNSYLVANIA STATE UNIVERSITY').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each entry begins with the institution name as the primary organizational identifier for the award; examples throughout: 'LEHIGH UNIVERSITY', 'TEMPLE UNIVERSITY', 'UNIVERSITY OF WASHINGTON'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principal Investigator (PI) / Project Director
rubrics_metrics.description: Name of the individual responsible for the project (e.g., 'TAYLOR, DOUGLAS H', 'HEIMER, RALPH T', 'GAUTEREAUX, IONE').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PI names are listed after the institution and are formatted as LAST, FIRST (often with initials). They identify the person accountable for project execution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project title / Program name
rubrics_metrics.description: Descriptive title of the funded activity indicating subject and target audience (e.g., 'SUMMER INSTITUTE IN MATHEMATICS FOR SECONDARY SCHOOL TEACHERS', 'IN-SERVICE INSTITUTE IN BIOLOGY AND EARTH SCIENCE FOR SECONDARY SCHOOL TEACHERS').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Project titles specify the program type (summer institute, short course, comprehensive project), subject area, and target audience; used to categorize the nature and focus of the award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant / Project code (award number)
rubrics_metrics.description: Parenthetical project or award identifier following the title (e.g., '(W006825)', '(W007419)', '(Y009372)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each award includes a unique code or grant number in parentheses which can be used for tracking, referencing, and administrative lookup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project duration / Period (months)
rubrics_metrics.description: Length of the funded project expressed in months (e.g., '10 MONTHS', '19 MONTHS', '24 MONTHS').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Duration is reported immediately after the project code/title and indicates the funded project period; some entries also indicate academic-year or specific year spans (e.g., 'ACADEMIC YEAR', '1974-75').

rubrics_metrics.name: Award amount (dollar value)
rubrics_metrics.description: Dollar amount of the award associated with the project (e.g., '$389,902', '$13,436', '$2,000').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetary award is given at the end of each record and may represent total funding for stated duration; amounts vary widely from small ($2,000 research-partner entries) to large program grants (hundreds of thousands).

rubrics_metrics.name: Program/Section categorization
rubrics_metrics.description: Higher-level program or category headings that group awards (e.g., 'SCIENCE EDUCATION SUPPORT', 'UNDERGRADUATE LEVEL', 'INSTRUCTIONAL PERSONNEL DEVELOPMENT').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document groups individual awards under section headings indicating program area or target educational level, useful for filtering or aggregating awards by program.
